stem.text: The diagram shows the direction of the current in a metal block. The charge carriers enter the block through the face PQRS and leave the block through the opposite face.

stem.text: The number density of charge carriers is $n$. Each charge carrier has charge $e$. The average drift speed of the charge carriers is $v$.
